app.name: Bus
app.tagline: Live Tallinn buses, trams, trolleybuses and Elron trains.

map.unavailable: The map could not be loaded. Check the connection; live data still updates.

vehicle.gone: This vehicle is no longer reporting.

home.title: My lines
home.empty: Saved lines with live countdowns arrive in a later update. Until then, the live map shows every vehicle.
home.intro: Save your everyday lines to see live countdowns and whether you can make it.
home.loginToSave: Log in to save your lines.
home.noLines: No saved lines yet. Open a line from Search and tap “Save line”.
home.noOrigin: Choose where you walk from to see whether you can make it.
home.unavailable: This line or stop no longer exists in the timetable.
home.noDepartures: No departures in the next hours.
home.addPlaceHint: Walking times on your lines start from the place you pick.

search.title: Search
search.soon: Search by line number or stop name is coming next.
search.hint: Try a line number such as 4 or 24A, or a stop such as Balti jaam.
search.label: Search lines and stops

settings.title: Settings
settings.credits: Map © <ofm>OpenFreeMap</ofm>, <osm>OpenStreetMap</osm> contributors. Data: Tallinna Transpordiamet, Elron, Maa- ja Ruumiamet (addresses).
settings.railLinesHint: Draw the train tracks on the live map, also when zoomed out.
settings.walkingIntro: How fast you walk and where from, for “can I make it?”.

stop.noDepartures: No departures in the next hours.

line.noPatterns: No timetable for this line right now.

auth.setupIntro: Create the administrator account. You can invite others afterwards.
auth.inviteInvalid: This invite is invalid, used or expired.
auth.signupClosed: Sign-up is closed. Ask an administrator for an invite.

sso.sso_unavailable: Single sign-on is not reachable right now. Try again shortly or use your password.
sso.sso_denied: Sign-in was cancelled at the provider.
sso.sso_expired: The sign-in took too long or was started elsewhere. Try again.
sso.sso_no_account: There is no account for this sign-in. If you already have one, log in with your password and link it under Settings → Single sign-on; otherwise ask an administrator for an invite.

account.title: Account
account.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
account.setPasswordHint: You sign in with single sign-on. A password also lets you log in without it.

sso.title: Single sign-on
sso.intro: Link your {{name}} account to sign in to this account with it as well as with your password.
sso.introOff: Single sign-on is turned off on this server.
sso.linked: Linked. You can now sign in with single sign-on.
sso.lastSignIn: Set a password first: this is your only way to sign in.
sso.adminGroup: This provider account is not in the administrators group, so signing in with it makes this account a regular user (unless it is the last administrator). Add it to the group at your provider, or keep signing in with your password.
sso.sso_link_taken: That provider account is already linked to another user. Unlink it there first.
sso.sso_link_session: The link was finished in a different session. Start again from here.

admin.title: Administration
admin.inviteLink: Invite link — shown once, copy it now
admin.publicMap: Public map (map, search and stops without login)
admin.backupHint: A consistent copy of the SQLite database (users, saved lines, settings).
admin.invalidNumber: Enter a number (the centre is “longitude, latitude”).
admin.resetRevokes: Their sessions and API tokens are revoked.
admin.visitorDefaultsIntro: Used until someone picks their own language or theme.
admin.liveIntro: Polled continuously; never faster than the feeds update.
admin.timetableIntro: Live departures per stop and the nightly import (03:30).
admin.walkProvidersHint: Tried in this order; a straight-line estimate is the last resort.
admin.politeIntro: Sent in the User-Agent of every upstream request, so data providers can reach you.

walking.title: Walking
walking.placesHint: Used as the starting point when location is off.
walking.mapHint: Move the map so the pin sits on the place, then confirm.
walking.orAddress: or search an address or stop
walking.nameFirst: Give the place a name first.

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.intro: For the Home Assistant integration and scripts. Tokens can read your lines and departures but cannot change anything.
tokens.name: Name
tokens.copyNow: Copy this token now — it will not be shown again.
tokens.revokeQuestion: Revoke? Apps using it stop working.

trip.title: Trip between two stops
trip.intro: Pick where you get on and where you get off. Lines that ride directly count, whichever comes first; if none do, or a change is quicker, pick a way with a change.
trip.none: No line rides directly between these stops.
trip.startPlaceHint: Walking time and the verdict start here whenever you are not sharing your location (also in Home Assistant without a “Walk from” entity).
trip.noneTryChange: No line rides directly between these stops — pick a way with a change.
trip.customHint: Pick the stop where you change (and a second one if you need it). Each ride must have a direct line.
